title: 第25章 快滚快滚第26章 合欢宗登门
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
那纯粹是找死。
小师叔一个眼神就能把他们冻成冰。
宁楚见两人不动，眉头一皱，刚要开口，鹤隐舟的声音从旁边传了过来，“听她的。”
顾玄和裴昭同时松了口气，动作麻利地撸起袖子，一人扛床头，一人扛床尾，抬着那张实木大床就往洞府里走。
宁楚跟在后面，双手叉腰，像个工地上的包工头。
她指挥着将床放在洞府里距离玄冰床最远的角落，阳光从洞口斜照进来，刚好能洒到床尾的位置。
不近不远，不冷不热，通风良好，位置绝佳。
宁楚双手叉腰，左右看了看，满意地点了点头。
完美。
顾玄和裴昭放下床，还没来得及喘口气，宁楚已经又走到了洞府门外。
“来来来，这里，”她指着洞府门口左侧一块相对平整的空地，“搭个棚子，当厨房用。”
两人深呼吸一口，看向鹤隐舟，鹤隐舟站在洞府门口，面无表情，像一尊不会说话的白玉雕像。
没阻止，那就是默许。
两师兄弟认命地开始搬木料，搭棚子。
宁楚站在一旁指手画脚，十分不见外。
宝儿也在一旁等，她看向宁楚的眼神中染上三分柔软。
眼前人的面容身形逐渐和记忆里的宁楚重叠在一起。
她们俩的性格，真的好像。
如果宁楚还在就好了。
宁楚没注意到她的目光，专心监工，突然鼻尖发痒，猛地打了两个喷嚏。

她抱着胳膊反复摩挲，抬头看了眼天色，喃喃自语道：“奇怪，这天儿也不冷啊，难道是昨晚冻感冒了？”
半个时辰后，简易厨房搭好了。
棚子不大，但五脏俱全。灶台、案板、水缸、柴火堆，一样不少。
裴昭甚至不知道从哪里搞来了一张旧桌子，摆在棚子下面，刚好够一个人切菜的位置。
宁楚在棚子里转了一圈，检查了每一个角落，确认没有遗漏，这才拍了拍手，从储物袋里掏出一堆野果。
是她之前在密林里摘的一直没吃，放在储物袋里保鲜到现在。
果子上的白霜还在，看着还挺新鲜。
她把野果塞进顾玄、裴昭、宁宝儿三人手里，“辛苦了辛苦了，吃点果子解解渴。”
宝儿接过果子，咬了一口，酸甜的汁水在嘴角溢开，她弯着眼睛笑了笑：“好甜。”
顾玄接过果子看了看，揣进了袖子里没吃，但也没扔，算是收了。
裴昭接过果子低头看了看，又抬头看了看宁楚，嘴角微微动了动，似乎想说什么，但最后只是把果子放进了储物袋里。
宁楚见他们收了东西，立刻换了一副面孔，笑眯眯地伸手做了个请的手势。
“行了，东西都搬完了，你们回去吧。天色不早了，路上小心啊。”
笑容灿烂，语气真诚，但翻译过来就四个字，快滚快滚。
宁宝儿被她推着往外走，一边走一边回头：“楚楚，有什么需要就传音给我，我……”
“知道了知道了，快走吧。”
三道剑光从天剑峰的方向亮起又消失，无妄峰重新安静了下来。
她一出去就是一上午，现在已经午时了，她有灵力护体，倒还不觉得饿。
content_en:
That is purely courting death.
The young master's uncle can freeze them into ice with just one look.
Ning Chu frowned when he saw the two of them not moving. Just when he was about to speak, He Yinzhou's voice came from the side, "Listen to her."
Gu Xuan and Pei Zhao breathed a sigh of relief at the same time, rolled up their sleeves quickly, one person carried the head of the bed, and the other carried the foot of the bed, carrying the big solid wood bed towards the cave.
Ning Chu followed behind, hands on hips, like a foreman on a construction site.
She directed the bed to be placed in the corner of the cave farthest from Xuan Bing's bed. The sunlight slanted in from the entrance of the cave, just enough to reach the end of the bed.
Not too close, not too far, neither too hot nor too cold, well ventilated and in a great location.
Ning Chu put his hands on his hips, looked around, and nodded with satisfaction.
Perfect.
Gu Xuan and Pei Zhao put down the bed. Before they could take a breath, Ning Chu had already walked outside the cave door again.
"Come on, come on, here," she pointed to a relatively flat open space on the left side of the entrance to the cave, "build a shed and use it as a kitchen."
The two took a deep breath and looked at He Yinzhou, who stood at the door of the cave with an expressionless face, like a speechless white jade statue.
If you don't stop it, you acquiesce.
The two brothers resigned themselves to their fate and began to move wood and build a shed.
Ning Chu stood aside and pointed fingers, very indifferent.
Bao'er was also waiting aside, her eyes looking at Ning Chu were filled with softness.
The face and figure of the person in front of him gradually overlapped with Ning Chu in his memory.
Their personalities are really similar.
It would be nice if Ning Chu was still here.
Ning Chu didn't notice her gaze and was concentrating on supervising the work. Suddenly, the tip of his nose felt itchy and he sneezed twice.
She crossed her arms and rubbed them repeatedly, looked up at the sky, and murmured to herself: "It's strange, it's not cold today. Could it be that you caught a cold last night?"
Half an hour later, the simple kitchen was set up.
The shed is not big, but it is fully functional. There are many stoves, chopping boards, water jars, and firewood piles.
Pei Zhao didn't even know where he got an old table and placed it under the shed, just big enough for one person to chop vegetables.
Ning Chu walked around the shed, checking every corner to make sure nothing was missing. Then he clapped his hands and took out a pile of wild fruits from the storage bag.
She had picked it in the dense forest before and never eaten it. She kept it fresh in a storage bag until now.
The white frost on the fruit is still there, and it looks quite fresh.
She stuffed the wild fruits into the hands of Gu Xuan, Pei Zhao, and Ning Baoer, "Thank you for your hard work, let's eat some fruits to quench our thirst."
Bao'er took the fruit and took a bite. The sweet and sour juice overflowed from the corner of her mouth. She bent her eyes and smiled: "It's so sweet."
Gu Xuan took the fruit, looked at it, put it into his sleeve without eating it, but didn't throw it away, so he accepted it.
Pei Zhao took the fruit and looked down, then looked up at Ning Chu. The corners of his mouth moved slightly, as if he wanted to say something, but in the end he just put the fruit into the storage bag.
When Ning Chu saw that they had collected their things, she immediately changed her face, smiled, and stretched out her hand to make a gesture of invitation.
"Okay, everything has been moved. You can go back. It's getting late, so be careful on the road."
The smile is bright and the tone is sincere, but it only translates into four words: Get out of here, get out of here.
Ning Baoer was pushed out by her, turning back as she walked: "Chu Chu, if you need anything, just send a message to me, I..."
"I know, I know, let's go."
Three sword lights lit up and disappeared from the direction of Tianjian Peak, and Wuwu Peak became quiet again.
She had been out all morning, and it was already noon now. She had spiritual power to protect her body, so she didn't feel hungry yet.
